capture.query: multiple (one query_range call per entry in 'responses')
capture.notes: One window, all six queries, as the CLI issues them. The real power/computing/up series were captured live and then clipped, and the slot series are authored, so that every sample stream carries the SAME deliberate 10-minute hole (2026-10-31T03:18:00Z .. 2026-10-31T03:28:00Z). That models a window where the host was not sampled at all: the gap must be reported as unknown, never as idle, and the shares must still sum to 100%.
